conviction_note: Mild long lean. The company's own July 16 briefing script says June orders were 'very strong' at the parent and the US subsidiary, coming off a Q4 with operating profit +65%. The Q1 comparison base is weak (OP 152m, -28% YoY), and Jun-Aug USD/JPY averaged about 160 against the plan's 145. Against that, the stock is +34% since the FY print and at YTD highs, and it fell 6-12% on its last two earnings-direction disappointments. A Q1 forecast revision is unlikely on this company's record. Findings sum +1.6, the scaled number is +0.48 (p_up 56 x abs 4.0). The gap is the reaction-function uncertainty on an extended stock, which belongs in p_up and not in the findings.
bar: There is no consensus (Yahoo earningsHistory has no estimates; one-analyst coverage at most). The bar is the company H1 plan (sales 5,830m / OP 675m / 経常 700m, FY 11,880 / 1,355 / 1,440) applied at this company's own Q1 share of H1: sales 46-48%, about 2,700m; OP 29-38%, about 200-255m. Source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592571.pdf and https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7713 . The bar is plan-derived, not street, so every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register as of 2026-09-29: 0.0%, no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, change 0.0 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Kabutan shows 信用倍率 '－': it is a 信用銘柄 (buy-side margin only, no 貸借), so there is no margin short to squeeze (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7713, 2026-10-09 10:11 JST). The 信用残 page was behind a CAPTCHA, so the margin long balance was not found. There is no option skew. Tape: run_up_20d +12.3%, 5d +3.2%. 2026-10-08 closed -4.5% on 63.6k shares, about 3x the September norm, and the stock was at YTD highs (2,724 on 10-07 against the 2,594 June high). priced_lean -0.62.

findings.finding: On the FY results call (2026-07-16) management said June orders were 'very strong' at both the Japanese parent and the US subsidiary, strong across all segments: optical elements/thin film for large electronics customers, alignment (調芯) systems for quantum/PIC/CPO, and system products. This follows Q4 FY26 sales +12.7% and OP +64.6% YoY, against a Q1 FY26 base of only 2,505m sales and 152m OP. A Q1 OP well above last year's 152m and at or above the plan-implied ~225m is the likely print, and kabutan would headline it as a large YoY gain.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Reaction from the prior close to the next close after the release, computed from Yahoo daily bars on kabutan's announced dates. Q1 FY26 (2025-10-09, OP -28%): -5.9%. Q3 FY26 (2026-04-09, 9M OP -13.5%): -12.1%. FY26 plus a +15% OP guide (2026-07-14): +5.7%. Q2 FY26 (2026-01-09, Q2 OP +10%): +0.5%. The stock trades on the direction of the quarter's profit and has not systematically sold good quarters.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is +33% from the 2,006 FY-print close and at YTD highs. What is not priced is the size of Q1. There is no consensus number anywhere, the comment covers June only, and the Q1 base is depressed. If the market already held a large Q1 beat, I would expect a pre-print run with sustained volume. Instead 10-08 sold -4.5% on heavy volume, which reads as holders de-risking, not pricing a beat.
findings.independence: Same company, a different document: the Q&A summary (https://www.sigma-koki.com/asset/data/20260716_QA.pdf, Q5) confirms the strong June orders by segment. The kabutan 3-month table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7713) confirms the Q4 momentum. All of this rests on company statements.

findings.finding: The FY27 plan assumes USD/JPY 145, EUR 170, CNY 21 and SGD 110. USD/JPY averaged about 160.8 in June, 162.5 in July and 158.9 in August 2026 (Yahoo JPY=X daily closes), roughly 10% weaker yen than plan. With about 40% of sales overseas and four overseas subsidiaries, translated sales, margins and non-operating FX lines all get a tailwind the plan does not include.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print where FX was the identifiable driver. FY26 ran at an average USD/JPY of 150.97 against a 140 plan and missed sales by 2.2% anyway, so FX alone did not carry that year.
findings.why_not_priced: FX is public to everyone, so this is mostly priced as a direction. The transmission to this company's Q1 is an inference until the release states it, which is why the finding is small.
findings.independence: Independent of finding 1, which rests on volume and orders rather than translation. The FX series and the company plan are different sources.

findings.finding: The stock goes into the print extended: +12.3% over 20 days, a new YTD high of 2,724 on 10-07 above the 2,594 June high, +33% since the FY print, PER about 19x on the guide. On 10-08, the session before the print, it fell 4.5% on about 3x normal volume. Q1 is the seasonally weakest quarter, and the last two prints that disappointed on direction drew -5.9% and -12.1%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-09 (Q1): the stock had risen into the print and fell 5.9%. 2026-04-09 (Q3): it had risen to 2,035, the high of that run, and fell 12.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up is in the baseline's priced_lean (-0.62) and is the free control, so this mostly agrees with what is already priced. It is kept small because it only matters if Q1 disappoints, and finding 1 argues it will not.
findings.independence: Same price series as the baseline's run-up. This is not independent evidence.

outside_window.finding: H1 forecast upward revision. On this company's record (kabutan 修正履歴) revisions came at the Q2 print (22/01/12, 25/01/10) or late in the year (24/05/23), not at Q1. If Q1 runs well ahead, the H1/FY revision most likely comes with or before the January 2027 print.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The baseline's cadence-estimated reaction of -2.91% on 2026-07-07 as the FY-print reaction
rejected_candidates.detail: The FY release was on 2026-07-14 at 15:00 per kabutan. The actual reaction was +0.75% that day and +4.94% the next. I used the real dates in reaction_history instead.

baseline_tension: The findings lean positive against a mildly negative priced lean (-0.62, entirely run-up) and an extended tape. The strongest positive the release could carry is a large YoY Q1 profit jump with order commentary; a revision or buyback is unlikely. I looked for both and found no pre-filing. The free control (-run_up) points the other way, which is why p_up is only 56.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already holds) and open question 4 (a run-in sized as a short was wrong once at +8.15%): the run-up/positioning negative went from -0.8 to -0.4, because it rests entirely on the public tape that priced_lean already carries.
Rule 2 (check for the strongest positive): I had already searched for a revision, a buyback and a dividend change before the print and found none filed. p_up stays at 56 and abs_move at 4.0.
